hooks.name: secrets-guard
hooks.description: Block built-in write tools (fs_write, fs_append, str_replace; IDE spellings such as fsWrite too) that target a .env* file. Exit code 2 blocks the call; .env.example stays writable. The matcher is a regex over tool IDs, so it works whether or not the surface also treats "write" as a category.

hooks.name: secrets-guard-shell
hooks.description: Block shell commands that redirect, copy, move, tee or sed -i into a .env* file.
